items.title: Fred Staton interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 12, 2008
items.q: Interviewer introduces himself as Monk Rowe and states he is interviewing Fred Staton.

ctx.x: Fred was interviewed in Clinton, New York on April 12, 2008 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and we are interviewing for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive at Hamilton College. I’m very pleased to have Fred Staton, saxophonist, as my guest.
